messages:
sarah-cs: heads up — Vireo reported a regress in their search rerank after last night's embedding model rollout. they see ~17% precision drop on their top-5 and tail latency up ~120ms. they attached a few examples. @alex-pm @priya-eng can you triage? :eyes:

mike-sales: Oof. Is this hitting production for all users or just their workspace? contract has a 99.5% relevance SLA, so flagging risk.

priya-eng: Can we get model version and rollout window? also need sample queries + before/after scores to reproduce. if it's the canary embedding we rolled at 02:00 UTC, i'll run a local eval.

jordan-data: please paste 10 failing queries and the top-10 results before/after. also include cosine similarity distributions if available.

sarah-cs: pasting two quick examples Vireo sent: they say this used to return support docs first but now prioritizes community posts. model change: redwood-emb-1.3 -> redwood-emb-2.0-canary (rolled 2024-05-15 02:10 UTC). latency numbers: median +12ms, p95 +120ms.

sarah-cs: ```
query: "How do I reset my API key?"
before_top1: doc_id=docs/1234 score=0.924
after_top1: doc_id=community/9876 score=0.851

query: "Billing error code 402"
before_top1: doc_id=docs/4455 score=0.913
after_top1: doc_id=kb/221 score=0.862
```

priya-eng: thanks. first pass: this looks like an embedding semantic shift — the new model clusters certain community text closer to these queries. need to run the eval harness on Vireo's seed set and compute MRR + top-k precision deltas. if confirmed, mitigation options: (1) rollback embedding for that tenant, (2) lower reranker weight, (3) add a post-filter boost for docs tagged official.

alex-pm: Can we scope work/time? For product backlog we need: acceptance criteria (e.g., top-5 precision recovers to within 3% of baseline), repro steps, dataset, namespace/tenant impact, and suggested roll-forward plan (A/B + rollback). Also estimate eng effort for mitigation + full fix.

mike-sales: Vireo says they are in mid-Q onboarding 20k users, this is high priority for them. please mark P1 if we need to escalate.

priya-eng: immediate ask for infra: can we flip canary flag for Vireo only? i can validate rollback locally within 30m. otherwise we risk more customers seeing drift.

support-bot: Created ticket CS-4567: "Vireo embedding regression" assigned to eng-ml. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4567 :white_check_mark:

alex-pm: I'll add a product backlog card with AC: include eval harness run, delta metrics (MRR, top-1/top-5), rollback plan, and a customer communication draft. set priority P1 until proven otherwise.

jordan-data: I'll start the A/B eval between redwood-emb-1.3 and redwood-emb-2.0-canary on their seed queries, will paste results here.

sarah-cs: Vireo asked for ETA on a fix. i'll tell them we have a ticket and are validating rollback now. thanks all. :raised_hands:
